description: This PHP source file manages the web interface for editing local user accounts in a network device or router management system. It includes JavaScript code for form validation, handles user input, and sends configuration data via AJAX to a server-side script.

methods.name: btn_save
methods.description: Collects user input for username and password, constructs a JSON config string, and sends it via AJAX POST request to update the local user configuration on the server.
